title: Find your way around Settings
text: Settings is grouped by topic, such as Business, Sales & Inventory, POS & Display, and Account & System. Each setting is saved per branch, and you may be asked for the admin password on first open.
steps: Click Settings in the sidebar. Type the admin password if asked.
Click Don't ask again to skip that prompt on this branch.
Use the search box at the top to jump to a setting by name.
Or choose a group on the left and then open the page you need.

title: Business details and what prints on receipts
text: Business Details stores the shop name, address, TIN, owner, email, and phone number that appear on receipts and reports. Each branch keeps its own details.
steps: Click Settings in the sidebar, then Business Details.
Fill in the fields you want to show on receipts and reports.
Click Save.
BIR, VAT, and permit details are read-only. Contact support to change them.

title: Receipt template and logo
text: Use this page to change how receipts look. You can save more than one template, upload a logo, and choose which one is active.
steps: Click Settings in the sidebar, then Receipts & Reports.
Stay on the Receipt tab.
Upload a logo, edit the header and footer text, and check the preview.
Type a name for the template and click Save.
Click Use to make it active, or Apply to all branches to copy it to every branch. BIR-registered stores keep the standard layout.

title: Report paper size, header, and page layout
text: Use Report Documents to control how printed reports look and how the Reporting page is laid out.
steps: Click Settings in the sidebar, then Receipts & Reports.
Open the Report Documents tab.
Pick the paper size: Short, Long, or A4.
Choose a header style and accent colour, then pick Classic or Side panel for the Reporting page.
Click Save when you are done.

title: Terminals and the serial number
text: A terminal is one register. Every payment is linked to the terminal that took it. Each terminal has its own serial number for BIR receipts.
steps: Click Settings in the sidebar, then Terminals. Every register on this branch is listed.
Click Rename to change a terminal's name.
Click the menu at the end of a row to Deactivate, Activate, or Reset Terminal Data.
To set each serial number, click Settings, then Business Details. The first terminal's number is the branch default.
Receipt Number Length sets how many digits receipt numbers use.

title: Back up your data
text: Backup downloads a copy of your products, inventory, customers, transactions, and settings. A full cloud backup also runs on its own every day.
steps: Click Settings in the sidebar, then Backup. Owners only.
Click Download Backup. Keep the file private.
Check the Daily schedule card to see when the automatic backup runs.

title: Reset settings or wipe a branch
text: Reset Settings puts preferences back to default and keeps all business data. Reset Branch Data deletes a branch's sales, products, and stock for good. It cannot be undone.
steps: Click Settings in the sidebar, then Reset. Owners only.
Reset Settings only touches preferences like order, payment, and scale options.
For Reset Branch Data, click the branch. Download your products and daily sales first.
Type the confirmation phrase. Customers, users, branches, and settings are kept.

title: Subscription, plan, and user slots
text: Account & Subscription shows each branch's plan, the next renewal, and your User Slots. Slots are shared across branches, so one person on many branches uses one slot.
steps: Click Settings in the sidebar, then Account & Subscription. Owners only.
Click Manage plans to upgrade or renew a branch.
Click Start trial on a branch to try Pro. It is one trial per store.
Click Add User Slots when you cannot add more staff.
Recent invoices are listed at the bottom.
